evidence.summary: A controlled 2x2 experiment showed that the effect of loan_amount depends on credit_history. At low credit_history, increasing loan_amount changed the score from 0.9430 to 0.9648, an increase of 0.0218. At high credit_history, increasing loan_amount changed the score from 0.8840 to 0.9512, an increase of 0.0672. The effect of loan_amount was therefore 0.0454 larger at high credit_history, indicating an interaction between the two parameters.
